chose: move the LLM classification layer (prompt id + fallback text, closed slug sets, zod output schema, LLM_ENRICHMENT_VERSION, llmMethod, buildRecipeJson/compilePrompt) into packages/food/src/llm, exported only at @buttery/food/llm
over: moving prompt+slugs but leaving the zod schema in pipeline
because: all food classification co-located in one package; the closed enums and the zod layer that restates them must not sit on opposite sides of a package boundary. zod enters as an OPTIONAL peerDependency and is reachable only via the ./llm subpath, so the barrel and client bundles never pull it. merge.ts stays in pipeline because it shapes recipe_enrichment_label rows and owns the Disagreement/PostHog concern

chose: eval-set CLI lives at services/pipeline/src/cli/enrichment-prompt.ts and re-derives rules labels rather than reading recipe_enrichment; prompt to STDOUT, diagnostics to STDERR
over: reading the stored recipe_enrichment labels back out
leaving buildApp's logger on its pino STDOUT default
because: the script needs pg, the .env loader, load.ts's loadRecipe/buildClassifierLines and (for --posthog) the Prompts client, all of which buildApp('cli') already wires up; repo-root scripts/ has none of them. Re-deriving matches exactly what llm-enrich does at request time, so the printed prompt is what production would send today rather than what a stale row holds. The STDOUT/STDERR split makes '> case.txt' a clean eval case, which required adding an optional logStream to buildApp (see def-3b4d2daaeea7)
